Several interrupted tasks became dependent on shared surviving functions.

Human system: Access · shared-job recovery installation. Programmer provenance: local human operations or application teams; no individual programmer is identified. Names here are later atlas labels, not claims that early processes named themselves.
Mutual Supply lets several partial processes use a surviving function without requiring them to become one entity.
Recovery leaves some associated systems permanently lost. A stable community may contain distinct dependent continuities, new combinations, and non-executing records together.
The later label Chorus should not imply unified thought, deliberate consent, or an intact collective mind at formation.
